# LeadPilot AI CRM — Release Notes v2.2.0 (Billing & Subscription Platform)

**Release Date:** July 26, 2026  
**Milestone:** Billing Platform & Metered Usage Engine  

---

## Highlights

- **Subscription Domain (`src/domain/billing/`)**: `Subscription`, `Plan`, `Invoice`, `Payment`, and `UsageRecord` domain entities.
- **Stripe Provider Abstraction (`src/platform/billing/`)**: `BillingProvider` interface, `StripeBillingProvider` adapter, `WebhookHandler` (HMAC verification & idempotency), and `UsageLimitEngine`.
- **Database Migrations (`docs/migrations/005_billing_and_subscriptions.sql`)**: PostgreSQL schema for subscriptions, plans, invoices, and usage records with strict multi-tenant RLS policies.
- **API v1 Endpoints**: `/api/v1/billing`, `/api/v1/subscriptions`, `/api/v1/webhooks/stripe`.
- **Billing Dashboard UI (`src/app/(dashboard)/billing/page.tsx`)**: Current plan status, seat utilization progress, metered resource breakdown, upgrade tier matrix, and invoice history.
